PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Server companion of the Sections client plugin: section editing and cutaways for the players of a dedicated server.
PluginData.Description:
Section editing and cutaways for the players of a dedicated server.
Players need the Sections client plugin from PluginHub. With this companion they can copy, cut, delete and blueprint grid sections on the server, and blocks they hide with cutaways or auto-hide lose collision for their own character only. Other players keep seeing and bumping into those blocks. Clients only send requests; every check runs on the server.
Admins only by default. The access levels for editing, for removing collision and for using other players' grids are in Sections.cfg in the instance folder.
Please see the full documentation on GitHub: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-sections
Bug reporting channel: #bug-reports SE Mods Discord https://discord.gg/PYPFPGf3Ca
